input._requiredNote: Narrowed 2026-08-10 to the three payloads that exist at BOTH gateways. The four downstream analyses were required, which made this agent unusable on the denial path: a claim denied at the eligibility gateway never reaches coverage, payout, credibility or decision, so requiring them faulted the job precisely when a refusal letter was owed. A denied claimant still gets a letter (process.md 3.8) — it just cites the eligibility finding and the reviewer's reason.

in_Outcome.description: The ending the claim actually reached, supplied by the case stage itself. Authoritative: no analysis, verdict or flag can override it.

in_ClaimDataJSON.description: Cleaned claim data with claimant name, address, locale, and policy number

in_EligibilityChecksJSON.description: Results of eligibility checks from Claims Eligibility Agent

in_CoverageChecksJSON.description: Coverage analysis results from Coverage Analysis Agent

in_PayoutChecksJSON.description: Payout calculation results from Payout Calculation Agent

in_CredibilityChecksJSON.description: Credibility assessment results from Credibility Assessment Agent

in_DecisionJSON.description: Final decision output from the Decision Agent

in_SettlementJSON.description: The settlement table the claimant is owed amounts from — see contracts/settlement-table.md. Every amount is a number and the currency is stated once, so quote them rather than restating prose. Deliberately not required: a claim denied at the eligibility gateway never reached payout analysis, so no settlement exists and the letter cites only the eligibility finding.

in_EscalationDecision.description: Human reviewer's decision for escalated claims: approve_full, approve_partial, or reject. Only provided when claim was escalated and reviewed.

in_EscalationComment.description: Human reviewer's comment or justification. Only provided when claim was escalated and reviewed.

out_ClaimResponseJSON.description: Decision letter content and metadata including full letter text Carries a `summary` field explaining the wording; replaces the former out_ClaimResponseAnalysisSummary output.

summary.description: Reasoning for the wording and tone of the letter.

letter_text.description: The complete letter to the claimant, ready to send, in the claimant's own language. This is the text the case plan mails out - no placeholders, no markup, no commentary about the letter.

decision.description: The outcome the letter communicates: approve, partial_approve, or deny. Must agree with in_Outcome; there is no pending or escalated value.
